snippet.title: Mayday: The Survival Island | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mayday: The Survival Island now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686230/Mayday_The_Survival_Island/ 

After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.
